editor.previewHint: Read-only preview: no editing plugins are mounted
editor.loadError.title: Could not open this map
editor.loadError.body: This is usually a network problem. Unsaved edits are kept locally and saved once the connection is back.
editor.loadError.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another account.
editor.draft.found: Local changes from {{time}} were found. Restore them?
editor.conflict.title: This map was changed elsewhere
editor.conflict.description: You have v{{mine}}, the server has v{{theirs}}.
editor.conflict.keepMineHint: Keep mine: overwrite the server with your content. Changes made elsewhere are lost.
editor.conflict.discardHint: Discard mine: load the latest server content. Your unsaved changes are lost.
editor.conflict.saveAsCopyHint: Save as copy: keep your content as a new map; the server copy stays untouched.
editor.leave.title: You have unsaved changes
editor.leave.description: Leaving now will discard your latest edits.
editor.leave.hint: A local draft is written first, so you can restore it next time you open this map.
editor.panel.label: Canvas panel
editor.panel.tabs.speaker: Present
editor.panel.speaker.title: Presentation mode
editor.panel.speaker.body: Play the map topic by topic. Coming in a later milestone.
editor.panel.style.autoWidthHint: Turn off to set a fixed width; longer text wraps
editor.panel.canvas.customEmpty: No saved themes yet. Tune the colours, then hit "Save current" to reuse them in any map.
editor.panel.canvas.customLocalOnly: Demo and stress-test documents are offline, so themes can't be saved here.
editor.panel.canvas.rainbowHint: Each first-level branch gets its own colour; off uses the scheme's first colour
editor.panel.canvas.layoutHints.autoBalance: Balance left and right branches by height
editor.panel.canvas.layoutHints.compact: Tighten spacing between siblings and levels
editor.panel.canvas.layoutHints.alignSiblings: Align topics of the same depth into one column
editor.export.title: Export map
editor.export.description: The preview is exactly what you get. SVG scales without loss.
editor.export.descriptionPng: The preview is exactly what you get. PNG is rasterised at the chosen scale.
editor.export.descriptionJpeg: The preview is exactly what you get. JPEG has no transparency.
editor.export.imageFailed: {{count}} image(s) could not be embedded; the export keeps the original link(s)
editor.export.tooLarge: {{width}}×{{height}} exceeds the browser limit ({{limit}}px per side). Lower the scale or use SVG.
editor.export.largeWarn: {{width}}×{{height}} is large; generating may be slow
editor.export.jpegOpaque: JPEG has no alpha channel; the background will be white
editor.export.failed: Could not generate the image. Try SVG or a lower scale.
editor.export.descriptionMd: The preview is exactly what you get. Markdown keeps text and hierarchy only.
editor.export.descriptionOpml: The preview is exactly what you get. OPML keeps text and hierarchy only.
editor.export.textWarning: Markdown and OPML carry no styling: re-importing loses colours, shapes, lines and layout.
editor.export.textSingleSheet: Text formats export the current sheet only.
editor.export.fontFallback: {{count}} character(s) have no glyph in the bundled font ({{chars}}); they will render with a system font
editor.export.split: Split by main branch ({{count}} files, zip)

import.title: Import
import.error.FILE_TOO_LARGE: This file is too large ({{size}}). The limit is {{limit}}.
import.error.NOT_A_ZIP: This is not a valid archive — the file may be corrupted.
import.error.UNKNOWN_FORMAT: Could not recognise the format of {{fileName}}. XMind, Markdown and OPML are supported.
import.error.UNZIP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The archive expands beyond {{limit}} (aborted while reading {{name}}). It may be a zip bomb.
import.error.ENTRY_TOO_LARGE: {{name}} expands to {{size}}, over the per-file limit of {{limit}}.
import.error.TOO_MANY_ENTRIES: The archive contains more files than the limit ({{max}}).
import.error.TOO_MANY_TOPICS: This map has more than {{max}} topics. Split it in the original app first.
import.error.PARSE_FAILED: Failed to parse {{fileName}} — the file structure may be incomplete.
import.error.ENCRYPTED: This file is password protected. Remove the password in XMind and try again.
import.error.EMPTY_DOCUMENT: No canvas was found. The file may be empty or corrupted.
import.warning.palette-fallback: The colour scheme does not match a built-in theme; the default palette was used.
import.warning.font-normalized: The font "{{from}}" is not supported and was mapped to the {{to}} family.
import.warning.gradient-flattened: Gradient fills were flattened to their starting colour.
import.warning.structure-fallback: The structure "{{from}}" is not supported and fell back to a mind map.
import.warning.table-degraded: Tables were degraded into a heading with one topic per row.
import.warning.attachment-noted: {{count}} attachment(s) were reduced to their file names.
import.warning.styles-ignored: The style definitions could not be read; the default theme was used.
import.warning.marker-unknown: {{count}} marker(s) are not supported and were skipped.
import.warning.title-truncated: {{count}} title(s) were too long and have been truncated.
import.warning.document-normalized: {{count}} field(s) did not match the schema and were corrected.
import.dialog.title: Import a mind map
import.dialog.description: XMind, Markdown and OPML are supported.
import.dialog.summaryDescription: Review the summary, then create the map.
import.dialog.restoredNone: Only the topic structure was restored.
import.dialog.unknownError: Import failed. Try a different file.
import.dialog.createFailed: Could not create the map. Please try again.
import.dialog.multipleFiles: Only one file can be imported at a time; using the first one.

share.title: Share "{{title}}"
share.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it manually.
share.revoked: Link revoked. That address no longer opens.

create.title: New link
create.passwordHint: At least 4 characters. Visitors must enter it before the map opens.
create.allowDownloadHint: When off, the share page hides the export entry. Note: the page must send the document to the browser to support collapsing and zooming, so a technical visitor can still read it via devtools — this lowers the barrier, it is not access control.
create.showNotesHint: When off, notes are stripped on the server — the response does not contain them at all.
create.done: Link created. Copy it and send it over:

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke this link?
revokeConfirm.body: The address stops working immediately, including copies already sent out. The record and its view count are kept.

mine.title: My shares
mine.subtitle: Every link you have handed out, and a way to take them back.
mine.emptyTitle: You have not shared anything yet
mine.emptyBody: Use "Share" on a map card, or open a map and use "Share" in the header.

public.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
public.invalidBody: It may have been revoked or expired, or the map may have been deleted. Ask the person who shared it for a new link.
public.disabledBody: An administrator disabled sharing, so every share link is temporarily unavailable.
public.passwordBody: The owner protected this map with a password.
public.passwordExpired: Your access expired. Please enter the password again.

templates.subtitle: Starting from a template beats starting from a blank page. Built-in templates are read-only — one click and you have a new map.

picker.disabled: User templates are turned off on this site; only built-in templates are available.
